R2/R3 failed primary substrate laws and R4 was rejected pre-render. CTF-01 therefore establishes one genuine second-family survivor after four judgeable images.

judgment.design_sol_view: R1 is strong enough to count as a genuinely distinct surviving second visual family because its fiber ontology constructs the whole surface and survives a materially different topology without copying the primary scene. This result warrants deliberate convergence comparison; it does not by itself justify selecting R1 over the current provisional family/control.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: The Director authorized CTF-01 by instructing continuation after Audit 11. No post-result Director taste input was used in primary or transfer scoring. The final convergence choice remains reserved to the Director.

mechanical: image budget consumed 4 effective judgeable images; no further CTF-01 image lawful
accessibility: R1's essential people, changed condition, quantity asymmetry and relational structure survive through silhouette, value, scale and large structural organization without dependence on hue, text or motion.

requires: consequential Director convergence review between the current provisional family/control and R1 second-family evidence before Phase-B exit or Phase-C work
constrains: future convergence must preserve the distinction between R1's whole-surface fiber ontology and literal textile decoration
no current-family mechanism may be silently imported into R1 merely to make comparison convenient, and no R1 fiber treatment may be silently imposed on the current family before selection
must_not_be_confused_with: production artwork or universal literal woven texture

known_integration_sensitivities: R1 is currently proven as a whole-surface representation family, not yet as a complete symbol/type/color/UI system.
Literal fiber density may become visually heavy at UI scale; any later convergence must test translation principles rather than assuming every surface becomes woven imagery.

The current provisional family/control has stronger packet-level symbol/wordmark/type/material/state/motion evidence; R1 has stronger whole-surface representational divergence evidence. The Director comparison must not pretend these evidence scopes are identical.
CLR-01 remains parked and final typeface, color, hero/static world, functional iconography and real-product synthesis remain unresolved regardless of R1 survival.
explicit_non_authority: No final identity family, final symbol, wordmark, typeface, palette, material system, imagery system, iconography, production motion token, app/site implementation, whole-app synthesis or Phase-C work is authorized by this packet.
No additional CTF-01 render, transfer, reroll, premise repair or topology replacement is authorized.
